subject: Interim coverage confirmation & bridge letter request for SylvanRanch SOC 2 period
messages:
From: Sara Collins <sara.collins@silvanranch.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim coverage confirmation (bridge note) for SOC 2 period

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last quarter. As part of our procurement checklist we need a brief interim coverage confirmation (commonly called a bridge letter) to cover the period after Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report end date through to today. Our SOC review requires the bridge to attest to control continuity and call out any material changes since the report period ended (report end date we have on file is 2027-12-31).

Could you confirm the following for us:
- Whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge letter covering 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-23 (today).
- Any material control changes or incidents since 2027-12-31.
- Recent KMS key rotation dates and whether key custody changed.
- Any org changes impacting the infra/security team in that window.

We will need the signed letter (PDF or DocuSign) and the following supporting artifacts if available: SOC 2 report PDF, a short KMS rotation log excerpt, and the most recent access review export. Our procurement contact is procurement@silvanranch.com — please CC them when sending the signed copy.

Can you let me know if 48 hours is a realistic turnaround? Happy to accept a draft first so legal can review.

Thanks,
Sara Collins
Head of Vendor Risk, SylvanRanch Health
Sara.Collins@silvanranch.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@silvanranch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim coverage confirmation (bridge note) for SOC 2 period

Sara —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a bridge letter that covers 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-23 and will include an attestation on continuity of controls and a short controls addendum. High level answers up front:
- No material security incidents since 2027-12-31.
- KMS key rotation: primary HSM key rotated 2028-01-11; custody remains with our KMS provider (no vendor change).
- Org changes: two senior infra hires in Jan/Feb (no leadership change in security).

I'll coordinate a draft for procurement and legal review. Could you confirm whether SylvanRanch requires the bridge letter on Redwood letterhead with an executive signature, or is an electronically signed DocuSign acceptable? Also confirm the exact end date you require (you proposed 2028-03-23).

We expect to have a draft within 48 hours; I'll loop in Marissa for the attestation language and Ben for the evidence bundle.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Bridge letter request — action items

Forwarding vendor ask — SylvanRanch needs a bridge note covering 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-23 and supporting artifacts. Please see details below (original message included).

Action items:
- Marissa: Draft the bridge letter language. Include: statement of SOC 2 Type II coverage (report ending 2027-12-31), attestation that no material security incidents occurred since report end date, brief summary of changes (KMS rotation 2028-01-11; two infra hires), and signature block for COO/CISO. Keep language concise and procurement-friendly.
- Ben: Pull the following artifacts into a zip: Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_20271231.pdf, KMS_rotation_log_excerpt.xlsx (export lines around 2028-01-11), access_review_2028-02-01.csv (user access review), and an internal change log excerpt showing the hires. Redact personal emails where necessary.

Target: initial draft and artifact bundle by EOD Thu 23 Mar so we can route to legal and then to the vendor for signature. If any item will slip, call it out here.

Thanks — I’ll take point on vendor communication.
Ava

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Draft bridge note for SylvanRanch — ready for review

Ava —

See draft text below (also attached as SylvanRanch_bridge_letter_draft.docx). Ben has attached the evidence bundle: SOC 2 PDF, KMS rotation excerpt, and access review CSV. I redacted PII in the access export as discussed.

--- DRAFT BRIDGE NOTE ---
Redwood Inference
[Redwood letterhead]

Date: March 23, 2028
To: SylvanRanch Health – Vendor Risk Team

Subject: Interim Controls Confirmation — SOC 2 Type II Period (report end date 2027-12-31)

This letter is provided at the request of SylvanRanch Health to confirm that, from 2028-01-01 through 2028-03-23, Redwood Inference has maintained the controls described in its SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2027-12-31). During this interim period Redwood confirms the following:

1) No material security incidents occurred that would have impacted the control environment covered by the SOC 2 report.
2) The primary key used by our KMS was rotated on 2028-01-11; key custody remains with our managed KMS provider and access is controlled via role-based procedures and logged key operations.
3) There have been limited personnel additions within the infrastructure team (two senior hires in Jan–Feb 2028); role-based access reviews have been completed and documented.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_20271231.pdf; KMS_rotation_log_excerpt.xlsx; access_review_2028-02-01.csv.

If you require additional detail or a different attestation scope (e.g., extended dates or a signed statutory declaration), please let us know and we will escalate.

Sincerely,
[Name]
[Title — CISO/COO]
Redwood Inference
--- end ---

Two quick notes: 1) I left the signer placeholder for legal to approve who signs (CISO preferred for controls attestation). 2) I created a DocuSign preview (link below) that can be used once legal signs off.

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.example.com/preview/ABC123-sylvanbridge

If this looks good I'll route to legal for signature and then send the DocuSign link to Sara and procurement per their request.

Marissa
Director, Compliance Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
